hypothesis: The causal near-minus-far ATM implied-vol term slope (term_slope) has a positive monotone (Spearman rank) relationship with subsequent forward variance risk premium (implied vol - forward realized vol) of the same underlying, independent of any trading wrapper; tested on real on-disk captures at the composed EVAL-74 term floor.
extends: EVAL-74 (same term_slope signal and sealed term floor) + EVAL-86 (same forward VRP target); distinct cell: term slope -> forward VRP

protocol.title: Options implied-vol term slope (near-minus-far ATM IV) -> forward variance risk premium (VRP) predictiveness (Spearman rank IC)
protocol.extends: EVAL-74 (same term_slope signal and sealed term floor) + EVAL-86 (same forward VRP target); distinct cell: term slope -> forward VRP
protocol.supersedes: nothing -- complements EVAL-74/84/85/86/87; no traded-form claim
protocol.signal: causal per-bar near-minus-far ATM IV term slope (EVAL-74 _term_bars: IV(near expiry)-IV(far expiry) in vol points), forward-filled and expanding-zscored end-of-bar k (reused e71._forward_fill/e61.expanding_zscore)
protocol.target_detail: forward VRP = atm_iv_k - forward_RV_{k+1..k+H}, forward_RV = e71._forward_rv = sqrt(mean(r^2)) (reused e86._forward_vrp verbatim)
protocol.statistic: Spearman rank correlation IC = rho(signal_z_k, forward_vrp_k); directional permutation H1: IC>0 (steeper near-minus-far slope -> richer forward VRP)
protocol.go_bar: GO only if, on BOTH BTC and ETH and at least one config, Spearman IC > 0, directional permutation p < 0.05, block-bootstrap 95% CI lower > 0, and pooled BH-FDR rejects that config; else NO-GO CONFIRMED (PASS).

data_availability.note: uses already-acquired real on-disk three-way captures (option trades with iv/strike/expiry + perp candles); no new acquisition, no network

floor.note: Reuses the sealed EVAL-74 term floor verbatim (EVAL-71 surface floor: min_option_trades_per_underlying=1000, min_near_atm_option_trades_per_underlying=400, min_perp_candles_per_underlying=1000, min_perp_span_seconds_per_underlying=82000s + term adequacy: >= MIN_DISTINCT_EXPIRIES distinct near-ATM expiries with >= MIN_EXPIRY_TRADES trades each and >= MIN_BARS_WITH_TERM bars with a non-null term signal), applied to BOTH BTC and ETH. Below the floor the campaign seals BLOCKED, never NO-GO. This is NOT the EVAL-64 ladder floor.
